MD KALIM Microsoft 365 Consultant | SharePoint Developer | Power Platform Kolkata, West Bengal | 8017123228 | mdkalim0153@gmail.com linkedin.com/in/md-kalim-34b502214

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Microsoft 365 Professional with 4+ years of experience in SharePoint Online, SharePoint 2013/2016/2019, SPFx, Power Platform, Microsoft 365 administration, workflow automation, migration, governance, and enterprise collaboration solutions. Experienced in solution design, stakeholder management, Microsoft Graph API integration, SharePoint REST API development, and business process automation.

CORE SKILLS SharePoint Online, SharePoint 2013/2016/2019, SPFx, React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse, Microsoft Graph API, SharePoint REST API, Microsoft 365, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint Migration, ShareGate, SPMT, Governance, Security & Permissions, Git, Node.js, Solution Design, Stakeholder Management.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE VALUE LABS Senior Software Engineer | Hyderabad | Jan 2026 – Present Client: IKEA | Role: SharePoint Developer

Developed and enhanced SPFx web parts for IKEA BPM tools to improve process

documentation accessibility and user experience.

Designed and implemented custom web parts to dynamically display process

documents based on Process GUIDs.

Upgraded 10+ legacy SPFx web parts to the latest framework versions.  Performed code refactoring and modernization of existing SharePoint solutions.  Collaborated with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions.

HEXAWARE TECHNOLOGIES SharePoint Developer | Pune | Jan 2022 – Dec 2025

Client: Sarepta Therapeutics | Role: SPFx Developer | May 2024 – Jan 2026

Developed SPFx web parts and extensions using React and TypeScript. 

Integrated SharePoint REST APIs and Microsoft Graph APIs for dynamic, real-time data rendering in SPFx components.

Created reusable SPFx extensions including Application Customizers, Field Customizers,

and Command Sets.

Deployed solutions and managed app distribution through the SharePoint App Catalog.  Optimized SharePoint data operations using CSOM and REST APIs.  Collaborated with business stakeholders to deliver scalable and reusable SharePoint solutions.

Client: Indigo Airlines | Role: SharePoint Developer | Aug 2023 – May 2024

Developed and deployed custom workflows and solutions in SharePoint 2013 and

SharePoint Online.

Supported SharePoint 2013 to SharePoint Online migration using ShareGate and SPMT.  Migrated 50+ SharePoint sites and content repositories while ensuring data integrity and minimal business disruption.

Configured SharePoint sites, lists, libraries, content types, and templates based on

business requirements. Implemented role-based security, permissions, and governance controls.

 Provided post-deployment support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution.

Client: Ernst & Young (EY) | Role: SharePoint Administrator | Jun 2022 – Aug 2023

Managed user access, permissions, and governance compliance across SharePoint

Online and SharePoint 2013 environments.

Supported 500+ users by resolving access, workflow, permissions, and content

management issues.

Built Power Automate workflows for operational and approval processes.  Created and managed site collections, subsites, lists, and libraries.  Handled site collection administration, including quota management and site administrator provisioning.

Worked closely with QA teams, Business Analysts, and UI/UX teams to deliver scalable

SharePoint solutions.

EDUCATION Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) | St. Thomas College of Engineering and Technology | 2017 – 2021

CERTIFICATIONS  Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)  Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900)  SharePoint Framework (SPFx) Development (Udemy)  AI Agent Development with Python (Udemy)  Git & GitHub Fundamentals (Udemy)  Professional Communication Skills (Udemy)
